map.name: rejections preserve the original error and permit later work
map.rationale: Visible unit-weight failure compatibility.

map.name: queued priorities run from smaller number to larger number with FIFO ties
map.rationale: Distinct priority bands mixed with equal-priority ties behind a running blocker.

map.name: successful weighted jobs release their entire reservation exactly once
map.rationale: Observes actual weighted reservation, full release, done conservation and full-capacity reuse.

map.name: failed weighted jobs release capacity and retain rejection identity
map.rationale: Exercises Job failure completion into datastore and a subsequent maximum-weight job.

map.name: priority selection and weighted release compose across backlog waves
map.rationale: Both modules must work through actual queue, registration, execution, free and re-drain across two waves.

map.name: oversized jobs reject without consuming running capacity
map.rationale: Guards rejected admission and later valid full-capacity use without asserting undocumented error text.

map.name: zero weight completion leaves running capacity unchanged
map.rationale: A zero reservation must not cause a negative running count or increase effective capacity.
